introduction: Virginia Law Help offers civil legal information, self-help tools and a route to local legal aid.
description: Virginia Law Help offers civil legal information, self-help tools and a route to local legal aid.

sections.who: Information is available online. Providers screen legal-aid requests for location, financial eligibility, issue and resources.
sections.get: You can learn about housing, family, debt and benefits issues and request legal help. Using a tool does not make a lawyer your representative.
sections.docs:
• Court papers and hearing dates.
  • Records relevant to the dispute.
  • Household information requested for legal-aid screening.
sections.apply:
1. Read the relevant topic

    Start at Virginia Law Help.

  2. Find intake

    Use its Get Legal Help tool by city or county, or call 866-534-5243.

  3. Explain deadlines

    State any hearing or response date and ask what help the provider can offer.
sections.after: Keep deadlines while awaiting a reply. Confirm whether a lawyer has accepted the case and the scope of assistance.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Virginia Law Help; Provider’s tools and intake contact; Court description of local lookup. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is the website a law firm for every visitor?
It supplies information and connections; representation requires acceptance.
How do I locate local legal aid?
The site has tools for specified forms and issues.
What if I have a court date?
Provide the exact date immediately during intake.
